important_scope_notes.GNoME: The page counts an unavailable 89M-frame training corpus; the catalog contains the ~381k publicly released near-stable structures. These are related coverage, not the same release or denominator.
important_scope_notes.Alex: The page describes an older ~30.5M-frame relaxation corpus; the existing Alexandria card describes a newer ~5.8M equilibrium-structure release. Related family, not identical count scope.
important_scope_notes.sAlex: Existing card counts train+validation together (11,000,983), while the page sAlex row counts only 10,447,765 training frames. Validation is now separately cataloged as an overlapping subset.
important_scope_notes.OpenLAM: Existing training-set card is unranked. The benchmark reports 162,507,178 configurations across 31 parents; retain as a benchmark-reported size rather than silently replacing unverified release counts.
important_scope_notes.ELEMENTA: The page reports the full 210,656,285-frame corpus, including unavailable frames; catalog cards cover the ~39M public core and separate ~4.7M Spin releases. Not identical release scope.
important_scope_notes.OCx24: The page materials count is 19,406 deduplicated computational candidates; the existing experimental card counts 5,412 rows of measurements. Both concern one project, but neither denominator is a number of independent crystal structures.
important_scope_notes.AFLOW: Repository counts evolve; the page snapshot does not overwrite the newer or differently scoped catalog count.
important_scope_notes.OQMD: The page uses OQMD v1.6 (November 2023); preserve current catalog version/count separately.
important_scope_notes.OMat24: The page reports 100,824,585 training configurations. Validation is a separate download with corrected December2024 files; do not infer a full release count from the training-only row.
important_scope_notes.QMOF: The page snapshot counts20,372 qmof_id records, whereas the existing catalog release may use a different archive/snapshot. Preserve version distinctions.
important_scope_notes.MAD-1.6: The page exact362,646 total is a benchmark recount of specified r2SCAN split files; existing card remains separately versioned and unranked until those payloads are independently checked here.
important_scope_notes.MatterSim: Training data remain unreleased; public code/checkpoints do not establish data access.
important_scope_notes.NOMAD: Represented as a repository/discovery resource rather than a fixed additional crystal corpus.
important_scope_notes.MatPES licensing: Primary current Hugging Face data card declares BSD-3-Clause whereas Matbench metadata lists MIT. New frozen2025.1 cards retain this mismatch; data-license verification remains unresolved.
